rules: Use Chivo for major headings with tracking-tighter for a compact, solid feel.
Use IBM Plex Sans for all body copy to give an engineered, technical vibe.
Use Barlow Condensed (uppercase) for overlines, labels, and small CTAs with wide letter-spacing (tracking-widest).
No rounded, friendly fonts. Everything should feel measured and robust.
ORA Blue (#1E3A8A) for active states, foundational UI elements, and structural highlights.
ORA Orange (#F97316) for kinetic triggers: primary CTAs, alerts, and dynamic data points. Use sparingly to maintain impact.
Never use pure black without grain or subtle texture.

shadows: No soft or muddy drop shadows.
Use sharp 4px or 8px solid block shadows (e.g. shadow-[4px_4px_0_#F97316]) for interactive 'rugged' elements.
borders: Implement the 'Grid Borders' style. 1px solid border-border on cards and containers to expose the 'skeleton' of the layout.
High-contrast 1px solid strokes instead of shadows.
textures: Subtle noise overlay on the primary background to make it feel tactile, like asphalt or metal.
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-none to rounded-sm. Keep it blocky, functional, and industrial.

component_guidelines.buttons: Square edges, high-contrast borders. Primary button should be ORA Orange with white text. Hover state must maintain at least 4.5:1 contrast. Use uppercase text.
component_guidelines.cards: Flat dark gray (#121212) backgrounds, 1px white/10 borders, no rounded corners. Grid-like layouts.
component_guidelines.navigation: Solid background (not transparent). Sticky top. Utilitarian layout.
component_guidelines.forms: Input fields should have sharp borders, dark backgrounds, and an ORA Blue focus ring.
component_guidelines.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (sharp/regular weight) for a technical and precise look.

layouts.general: Responsive grid layout (12-column). Emphasize structural alignment.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-8, p-12, or p-16 to give breathing room. Elements should not feel cramped.
layouts.hero: Asymmetric bento grid or large high-contrast typography split-screen. Use images of PEI industries behind dark overlays.
layouts.solutions_bento: Use Mode B: High Density Grid (from <Spacing and Layout Strategy>) for the Solutions and Products pages. Every pixel must be utilized with sharp borders dividing the items.

motion.interactions: Micro-interactions should be fast and mechanical. No bouncy easing. Use linear or sharp ease-out curves.
motion.page_transitions: Fade and slight upward reveal. Staggered entrance for grid items.
motion.hover_states: Slight scale (1.02) or border color change. Must feel instantly responsive.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against dark backgrounds passes WCAG AA minimum 4.5:1.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have a visible focus ring (ORA Blue or Orange).

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and setup dependencies: framer-motion, lucide-react (or @phosphor-icons/react), react-router-dom.
Configure tailwind.config.js with the specified colors (ORA Blue #1E3A8A, ORA Orange #F97316, Dark Base #050505) and fonts (Chivo, IBM Plex Sans, Barlow Condensed).
Build standard React (.js) components, NO TypeScript.
Create the 5 main pages: Home, About, Solutions, Products, Contact. Set up routing.
Use Shadcn UI logic where applicable, but override styles entirely to match the rugged, border-heavy, non-rounded industrial look.
Implement the 'Grid Borders' style for data display and feature cards. Expose the structural layout.
Avoid using any transparency on surfaces that sit over scrolling text. Stick to opaque dark gray.
Hero section on Home page must feature an asymmetrical grid overlaying the background image or solid dark section.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, and forms.
universal_guidelines: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but keep borders stark.
DO NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add specific transitions.
DO NOT center align the entire app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
DO NOT use emojis as icons. Use the specified icon library (Phosphor or Lucide).
Ensure generous padding in sections (py-20, py-32).
All interactive elements MUST have hover states (change background/text color).
Use the provided brand image URLs. Do NOT use placeholder text where an image is required.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Not strictly necessary for this rugged blue-collar site. Keep it lightweight. If background motion is desired, use Framer Motion for subtle grid-line tracing or CSS noise animations.
